8048.title: Global Git helper reset suppresses unrelated HTTPS credentials
8048.rootCauseOneLine: The command-scope unscoped credential.helper reset clears unrelated local helpers, while its replacement serves only HTTPS github.com.
8048.proposedFix: URL-scope the reset and forwarded helper to HTTPS GitHub; preserve rewrite behavior and add a real-Git local-helper preservation regression test. Requires maintainer authentication review.
8048.caveats: Reproduced twice offline on Linux/Git 2.39.5 with the exact production environment generator; no live macOS enrollment or private remote tested. Reproduction source and output are inline per report repository policy. No autofix because authentication changes are excluded.
